summaryDeep: Their sense of identity, confidence, and direction work smoothly with your thinking and how you talk and decide. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Still, every gift asks something of us. The ease here can make it tempting to assume that understanding will always be available. You may stop sharing the parts of yourself that are changing. They may rely on what they already know instead of staying curious about who you are becoming.
advice: This connection works best when both people stay engaged. Do not assume you already know each other. Keep sharing what is changing in your life. The understanding between you is a strength, and it keeps growing when you both stay informed.
